steps.text: Hey 😊 I woke up before my alarm and now half past three feels about a week away
You can go back to sleep. I'll wake you up in June
Very helpful
I was fine last night. Now I'm checking the time while the kettle boils
I already had breakfast, before you ask
You remembered ❤️
I could practically hear tomorrow's lecture before I went to bed
That's called being a good influence
Have you eaten, or are you just supervising everyone else?
I have food right here, thank you
That looks considerably better than what I made
You could try putting something on the plate instead of eating over the sink
You weren't here. You can't prove anything
I know you
I have the group meeting this morning, then I'll come home and get changed
Still wearing the dress from yesterday?
Yes. I'm refusing to start that decision again
I want to ask you something before I go, though
What is it?
About today. About limits, I suppose
We've talked about what you want to know afterward, but not quite about this
When we said coffee, did we mean coffee and nothing else?
No. We picked somewhere for you to meet, not a rule about where the afternoon has to stop
So if it goes well and I want to stay longer, I'm not supposed to come home just because that's all we mentioned?
Of course not
I want you to do what you feel like doing, not keep checking whether it was on a list we made this morning
And if I want to kiss him?
Then kiss him
You say that very easily
Because I mean it
And if I want to go further than that?
I'm not going to set a limit for you
No limits from me. I want you to decide what you want, not what you think I want you to do
Really?
Really. You don't have to ask me for permission at every step
I don't know what I'll feel like yet
You don't need to know already
Maybe you have one coffee and leave. Maybe you want to spend the rest of the afternoon together
I don't want you stopping yourself just to fit a plan, or pushing yourself to make the story more interesting for me
That was the bit I was worried about
Coming home and feeling like I'd either done too much or disappointed you by not doing enough
There's no amount you have to do to make today a success
So I decide what I actually want, and see what he wants too
Exactly
And I can still change my mind in the middle of it
Obviously. This isn't you promising anything to either of us
Okay
That's a much bigger answer than I was expecting
Last night you said it suddenly felt much more real. Has that changed?
Not entirely. I still notice it when I think about you actually being there
But feeling nervous doesn't mean I want to make your decisions for you
Don't turn being relaxed into another thing you have to perform for me
I won't. I'll tell you if something feels different
Good. I want the real answer from you, even when it takes a minute
Are you still smiling like you were last night?
Yes. A little distracted too, but I'm looking forward to hearing how you feel
Just don't decide how my entire afternoon goes before I've even left the house
I'm trying to concentrate on the girl who keeps texting me instead
She sounds lovely
She is ❤️
Even with {{name:aiden}}? Knowing we'll still see him around afterward?
Yes. I haven't forgotten who we're talking about
I trust you. I'm not asking you to spend the whole date protecting me from finding it strange
He might be the one who needs a minute today
Still trying to understand yesterday?
Probably. I'm not sure the words "my boyfriend knows" have completely settled in yet
Let him order something before you surprise him again
I'm not giving a second presentation. He can cope 😌
And I'm still meeting someone I don't actually know yet
Exactly. Being free to choose doesn't mean you suddenly have to trust him with everything
I still want to see what he's like over a coffee first. That hasn't changed
Then that's where you start
I liked his messages. I don't want to spend the date wondering whether I'm matching the version I imagined
You might find the real person more interesting
As long as he leaves the cooking to the café, we have a chance
And when you said I could keep some things to myself, we'd only talked about a first date
I wanted to say this part out loud before treating that answer like it meant anything more
I'm glad you did. Now you know I want you to choose for yourself, rather than stop at the coffee because of me
Okay. Some things can stay mine without us misunderstanding each other
Yes. And anything that worries either of us is still something we talk about
I thought you were going to give me a very careful answer about what was allowed
I mostly want you to stop treating your own feelings like the least important part
I'm trying
I like that you want me to do this as me, not as some version of myself I have to invent
That's the girl I'm in love with
That was unfairly sweet ❤️
Now I've forgotten what I was looking for before you made me smile at the kitchen table
Keys?
Yes, actually
Look at me, useful and charming
Let's not ruin it
I'll text you when I'm getting ready later
Have a good morning. And eat before the meeting swallows your lunch break
You really are stealing my job today
